name: NPC and monster spellcasting resources
description: NPCs, monsters, and player characters use the same native qualifying spell-resource framework; source presentation alone does not mandate slotless monsters or grant them unearned slots.

resourceProfiles.slotChoice: Use source-supported explicit slot grants or explicitly authorized slot-expending abilities at their actual spell levels and counts.
resourceProfiles.spellPointChoice: Spell points are an alternative representation of the same qualifying expendable pool, not additional simultaneous uses.
resourceProfiles.selection: GM chooses applicable slot or point profile for eligible NPCs and monsters; presence of spell-like abilities alone does not entitle a creature to any pool.

independentGrants.limitedUse: Preserve each explicit limited use and recovery schedule
independentGrants.innate: Preserve innate powers and their own permissions
independentGrants.slotUse: Requires actual separately authorized spells and slot expenditure; a pool never supplies missing spells

restoredAbilities: A compatible older spell-slot-powered ability may coexist with a newer action when restored, but duplicate consequences are not counted twice.

example.retains: Current Priest attacks, casting and Divine Aid; restored Divine Eminence can expend the source-supported older pool.

unresolved: Native spell-point exchange and exact runtime effect interpretation; do not infer new slots for other spellcasting monsters.
